 Where most local sites stall
 Work comes by word of mouth, not from Google 
 1 Where you are now
 Your website was built years ago and nobody has touched it since. Work comes from word of mouth, not from Google. The quotes you have had are hard to compare, and you are not sure what the monthly fee covers.
 2 What that is costing
 When someone in Andover searches for what you do, they choose from the firms they can find. A slow site, or one that does not say clearly what you do and where, sends that enquiry to someone else. Each month it stays that way, the firms above you pull further ahead.
 3 Where it could be
 A site that says what you do, where you work and how to book. It loads fast on a phone and is set up for Google from day one. One fixed price, one person to call, and AI tools added later only when they earn their keep.

 Common questions
 What Andover owners want to know first 
 Are you actually based in Andover?
 Yes. Antek Automation is at Chantry House, 38 Chantry Way, Andover, Hampshire SP10 1LZ, and Andy builds every site himself.
 Do you work outside Andover?
 Yes, across the Test Valley and the rest of Hampshire. Most of the work is done by phone and video, so distance is no issue.
 What is local SEO and do I need it?
 It is the work that helps you show up when people nearby search on Google and Maps. The technical side is in every build, and the local SEO page explains the optional monthly service.
 What will my Andover website cost?
 Five pages is £600 and eight pages is £995. Any page beyond that adds £125, and hosting and care is £10 a month.
 When could my site be live?
 Usually 1 to 3 weeks after your deposit, depending mostly on how quickly your photos and details arrive.
 If I stop working with you, what happens to the site?
 You own the site once it is paid for.
 Your web designer is already in Andover.

## https://andoverwebsitedesign.co.uk/about-andy

Who builds your site
 Andy Norman, building websites from Andover 
 Andy started out as a field engineer and spent more than 30 years in field service and managed print, working his way up to service manager.
 He set up Antek Automation in Andover to give local firms what he had rarely seen them get: a straight price, plain advice and a website that does a job.
 Why local matters to him
 Most of his clients could work with him entirely online, and many do. Being in town simply means an Andover client can put a face to the name and sit down if that helps.

## https://andoverwebsitedesign.co.uk/local-seo

Local SEO · Andover
 Local SEO in Andover, and what it involves 
 Every Andover build already includes technical SEO and schema, so Google can read what you do and where. Ongoing local visibility support is a separate service from £497 a month.
 Searches such as seo Andover usually lead to a map result first, which is why this work centres on your Google profile and reviews.
 What the monthly service includes
 You get a fixed scope, and each month you can see what was done.
 A monthly LocalFalcon map-rank report
 Review requests and replies through the CRM
 Scheduled Google profile posts and upkeep
 A monthly summary in plain English
 What is not offered
 Citations are available as an add-on. Andy does not offer ranking guarantees, link building or ads, because he would rather tell you that now than after you have paid. See the full service for how this fits with a new site.
 Ask Andy about local SEO
